$description: Color / Active — info mode. All values alias the 'info' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it info-colored (informational, help, links). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'info'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for info components

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for info-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for info-colored components
